pricing/infra.json: the infrastructure prices a run resolved, so servtuner analyze prices from this copy and never from a live source. The manifest's checksum covers it.

Schema file: `schema/json/bundle/infra-pricing.schema.json`. Generated from servtuner commit `5730cfa50f08`.

## Top level

| Field         | Type                                                            | Required | Description                                                            |
| ------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------- | -------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `source`      | `"static"`, `"aws"`                                             | Yes      |                                                                        |
| `resolved_at` | [utcTimestamp](/reference/schemas/common/#utctimestamp)         | Yes      |                                                                        |
| `discount`    | `number`                                                        | Yes      | Applied by the analysis, not folded into the prices below. &gt; 0; ≤ 1 |
| `query`       | array of `string`                                               | No       | For aws: the Price List filters used, one per instance type.           |
| `nodes`       | map of [nodePrice](/reference/schemas/infra-pricing/#nodeprice) | Yes      | Keyed by instance type.                                                |
| `gpus`        | map of [gpuPrice](/reference/schemas/infra-pricing/#gpuprice)   | Yes      | Keyed by GPU model: per-GPU prices from the static table.              |
| `problems`    | array of `string`                                               | No       | Instance types or models the source could not price, and why.          |

## Definitions

### nodePrice

| Field          | Type      | Required | Description                                                          |
| -------------- | --------- | -------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `usd_per_hour` | `number`  | Yes      | ≥ 0                                                                  |
| `cores`        | `number`  | Yes      | &gt; 0                                                               |
| `memory_gib`   | `number`  | Yes      | &gt; 0                                                               |
| `gpus`         | `integer` | Yes      | ≥ 0                                                                  |
| `gpu_model`    | `string`  | No       | From the source when it names one (aws: the gpu attribute's family). |

### gpuPrice

| Field          | Type     | Required | Description                                                                 |
| -------------- | -------- | -------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `usd_per_hour` | `number` | Yes      | ≥ 0                                                                         |
| `basis`        | `string` | Yes      | How the price was set: given, or the owned-hardware helper with its values. |
